headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with AI as a key driver.
summary: Coforge posted the strongest YoY revenue growth at 53.6% and raised its EBIT margin guidance. Infosys trimmed FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% and saw modest top‑line growth. Most peers reported double‑digit growth, driven by AI‑led deals and higher margins. Profit trends varied, with HCLTech and TCS posting strong gains while Infosys and Wipro saw slower profit expansion.

themes.title: AI‑driven growth
themes.detail: Several companies highlighted AI revenue surges and AI‑led deals as a major growth catalyst.

themes.title: Margin and guidance shifts
themes.detail: Coforge raised EBIT margin guidance, Infosys cut revenue guidance, and HCLTech introduced new FY27 guidance.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised FY27 EBIT margin guidance to 16%.

laggards.why: Revenue grew only 1.5% YoY and FY27 revenue guidance was cut to 1‑2%.
